people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces, arose, and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
translations.bsb: Then all the people small and great, together with the commanders of the army, arose and fled to Egypt for fear of the Chaldeans.
translations.kjv: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
translations.asv: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces, arose, and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
